शल् {vI.v} {c1c} A. (शलते)
1 To shake,
stir, agitate.
--2 To tremble.
--3 To
cover. {vII.v} {c1c} P. (शलति)
1 To go.
--2 To run fast. {vIII.v} {c10c} A.
शालयते To praise.

शाल् {c1c} A. (शालते)
1 To praise,
flatter.
--2 To shine.
--3 To be
endowed with; Malli. on

शलः [शल्-घञ्]
1 A dart, spear.
--2 A stake.
--3 N. of शृंणि an
attendant of Śiva.
--4 N. of Brahman.
--5
A camel.
--लं The quill of a
porcupine (m. also according to some).

.
--3 An enclosure, a fence.
--4
A kind of fish.
--5 N. of king
Sālivāhana.
--Comp.
--ग्रामः a kind
of sacred stone said to be typical
of Viṣṇu, as the Phallus is of
Śiva. ˚गिरि N. of a mountain. ˚शिला
the Sālagrāma stone.
--जः,
--निर्यास; exudation of the Sāla tree, resin;

. {2}
a courtezan, harlot.
--भंजी a doll,
puppet.
--वेष्ट्रः the resin of the
Sāla tree.; cf. साल.
--सारः {1} a
superior tree. {2} asa foetida.

1 N. of a tree or its resin.
--2 A tree in general, as in
कल्पसाल, रसालसाल.
--3 A rampart, a fence
or wall round a building.
--4 A wall
in general.
--5 A kind of fish. (For
compounds see under शाल).

शल्लकः N. of a tree.
--कं Bark,
rind.

]
1
A grass-hopper, locust; Ś. 1. 32.
--2
A moth; कौरव्यवंशदावेऽस्मिन्क एष
शलभायते

शललं The quill of a porcupine.
--ली
1 The quill of a porcupine.
--2
A small porcupine.

.
--2 A
pencil, small stick (used in
painting the eyes with collyrium),
अज्ञानांधस्य लोकस्य ज्ञानांजनशलाकया ।
चक्षुरुन्मीलितं येन तस्मै पाणिनये नमः ॥
Śik. 58;

.
--3 An arrow.
--4
A dart, javelin.
--5 A probe or a
kind of pointed surgical instrument.
--6 A rib (as of an umbrella).
--7
A bone (forming the root of the
fingers and toes);

--8 A
sprout, sprig, shoot; उद्भिन्नया
रत्नशलाकयेव

.
--9 A paint-brush.
--10 A tooth-brush, tooth-pick.
--11
A porcupine.
--12 An oblong piece
of ivory or bone used in gambling.
--13 A ruler.
--14 The Sārikā bird.
--Comp.
--धूर्तः (forming
शलाकधूर्तः) a swindler, sharper.
--परि ind.
an unlucky throw or movement of
one of the pieces at a game played
with Śalākas: cf. परि or अक्षपरि.
सल्लका A kind of tree; cf. शल्लकी.

शलाटु a. Unripe.
--टुः A kind
of root.

.
--2 Bark, rind.
(of trees).
--3 A part, portion,
fragment.

.
--2 Bark, rind.
(of trees).
--3 A part, portion,
fragment.

.
--2 One of
the seven great divisions of the earth.
--3 N. of a kind of hell.
--Comp.
--स्थः an epithet of Garuḍa.

1 The silk-cotton tree.
--2
N. of a river in Pātāla.
--3 A kind
of hell.
--Comp.
--वेष्टः, --वेष्टकः the
gum of the silk-cotton tree.

शल्यं [शल्-यत्]
1 A spear, javelin,
dart.
--2 An arrow, a shaft; शल्यं
निखातमुदहारयतामुरस्तः

; शल्यप्रोतं
9. 75; अवगच्छति मूढचेतनः प्रियनाशं
हृदि शल्यमर्पितं

.
--3 A thorn, splinter.
--4 A
pin, peg, stake (said to be m. also
in these four senses).
--5 Any
extraneous substance lodged in the
body and giving it very great pain;
अलातशल्यं

; अपनीताशेषशल्यः
Dk.
--6 (Fig) Any cause of
poignant or heart-rending grief;
उद्धृतविषादशल्यः कथयिष्यामि Ś. 7.
--7 A
bone.
--8 Difficulty, distress.
--9 Sin,
crime
--10 Poison.
--11 Abuse,
defamation.
--ल्यः
1 A porcupine,
hedge-hog.
--2 The thorny shrub.
--3
Extraction of splinters.
--4 A fence,
boundary.
--5 The Bilva and
Madana trees.
--6 A kind of fish.
--7 N.
of a king of Madra and brother of
Mādrī, the second wife of Pāṇḍu,
and thus maternal uncle of Nakula
and Sahadeva. [In the great war
he at first intended to fight on the side
of the Pāṇḍavas, but he was artfully
won over by Duryodhana and
subsequently fought in his behalf. He
acted as charioteer to Karṇa when he was
generalissimo of the Kaurava forces,
and after his death was appointed
commander. He maintained the field for
one day, but was at last slain by
Yudhiṣṭhira].
--Comp.
--अरिः an
epithet of Yudhiṣṭhira.
--आहरणं,
--उद्धरणं, --उद्धारः, --क्रिया, --शास्त्रं
extraction of thorns or splinters, or that
part of surgery which relates to the
extraction of extraneous matter
from the body.
--कंठः a porcupine.
--लोमन् n. the quill of a porcupine.
--हर्तृ m. a weeder.

1 A dart, javelin, spike.
[]
--2 A splinter, thorn.
--3 A
porcupine.

शल्यित a. Pierced(as with a
dart); निष्कारणपरित्यागशल्यित

1 A porcupine.
--2 A
kind of tree (of which elephants are
very fond); अभिलेढु
तावदासवसुरभिरसं शल्लकीभंगं
शल्वः N. of a country; see शाल्व.

1 N. of a country.
--2 A
king of Sālva.

1 N. of a country, or its
inhabitants (pl. in this sense).
--2
N. of a demon slain by Viṣṇu.
--Comp.
--हन् m. an epithet of
Viṣṇu.

शाला [शाल्-अच्]
1 An
apartment, a room, saloon, hall;
गृहैर्विशालैरपि भूरिशालैः Śi. 3. 50; so
संगीतशाला, रंगशाला &c.
--2 A house, an
abode;

.
--3 The upper
or main branch of a tree.
--4 The
trunk of a tree.
--5 A stable, stall; as
in वाजिशाला, गर्दभशाला &c.
--Comp.
--अजिरः --रं a hollow earthen cup.
--मृगः a jackal.
--वृकः {1} a dog;
सिंहानां च सुखेन मूर्घसु पदं धास्यंति
शालावृकाः

1 A wall, rampart.
--2 A
house, an apartment; see शाला.
--Comp.
--करी {1} a house-worker.
{2} a male captive (particularly one
taken in battle).
--वृकः see शालावृक.

शालाकिन् m.
1 A lancer,
spearman.
--2 A surgeon.
--3 A barber.

शालातुरीयः An epithet of
Pāṇini (written also शालोत्तरीय; so called
from शलातुर the place of his birth).

1 A flight of steps, ladder.
--2 A bird-cage.
--3 The claw of an
elephant.

सालारं A peg projecting from a
wall, bracket.

.
--2
The civet-cat.
--Comp.
--ओदनः --नं
boiled rice (of a superior kind).
--गोपी a female appointed to watch
a rice-field; इक्षुच्छायनिषदिन्यः
शालिगोप्यो जगुर्यशः

.
--चूर्णः --र्णं
rice-flour.
--पिष्ट्रं a crystal.
--भवनं
a rice-field.
--वाहनः N. of a
celebrated sovereign of India whose
era commences with 78 A. D.
--होत्रः {1} N. of a writer on
[]
veternary subjects. {2} a horse.
--होत्रिन्
m. a horse.

1 A weaver.
--2 A toll,
tax.
--3 A village of artisans.

शालिन् a. (नी f.) (usually at
the end of comp.)
1 Endowed with,
possessed of, possessing, shining or
resplendent with;
अलघूपलपक्तिंशालिनी Śi. 16. 76,

1 A mistress of the house,
housewife.
--2 N. of a metre; see
App. I.

; Śi. 16. 83.
--2 Like,
resembling
--नः A householder. (
शालीनीकृ ‘to make humble, humiliate’).

शालुः [शाल्-उण्]
1 A frog.
--2 A
kind of perfume.
--3 A kind of
astringent substance.
--लु n. The
root of the water-lily.

शालु(लू)कं
1 The root of the
water-lily.
--2 Nutmeg.
--कः
1 A
frog.
--2 The root of the
waterlily (शालूक only in this sense).

शालु(लू)कं
1 The root of the
water-lily.
--2 Nutmeg.
--कः
1 A
frog.
--2 The root of the
waterlily (शालूक only in this sense).

सालेयं^1 A kind of fennel; see
शालेय.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170209. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/336. note: n. noun needs anusvAra ending.

शालोत्तरीयः An epithet of
Pāṇini; see शालातुरीय.

शाल्मलः [शाल्-मलच्]
1 The
silk-cotton tree.
--2 One of the seven
great divisions of the earth.
--3 The
gum of the cotton-tree.

शाल्मलिकं An inferior kind of
Śālmali tree.

]
1 Water;
सुभगसलिलावगाहाः Ś. 1. 3.
--2 The
constellation उत्तराषाढा.
--Comp.
--आर्थिन् a.
thirsty.
--आशयः a tank, reservoir
of water.
--इंधनः the submarine
fire.
--उपप्लवः inundation, deluge,
flood of water.
--कुंतलः moss.
--क्रिया the funeral rite of washing a
corpse. {2} = उदकक्रिया q. v.
--जं a
lotus.
--निधिः, --राशिः the ocean.
--रयः a current, stream.

सलील a. Sportive, wanton,
amorous.
--लं ind.
1 Playfully.
--2 Affectionately.

सलोकता Being in the same
world, residence in the same heaven
with a particular deity, (one of the
four states of Mukti).

1 The resin of the Sāla
tree.
--2 Resin in general.

1 Being in the same
world or sphere with another.
--2
Residence in the same heaven with
any deity.

साल्विकः The bird called सारिका
q. v.
